old_title: Woman arrested after baby found dead in Sydney bin
new_title: Woman charged after baby found dead in Sydney bin
old_text:
Police arrest woman believed to be mother of baby found dead in Sydney bin
In short:
A woman believed to be the mother of a baby found dead in a Sydney bin last month has been arrested.
In a statement, police said she was taken to hospital for assessment and arrested after she was released.
She has been taken to Auburn Police Station, where inquiries are ongoing.
